lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The index goes back further than the Enclave system does. Further than the Steward does.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Two hundred and eighty-one years. Every quarter. Never late, never queried, never once flagged by an auditor, and I am the eleventh auditor to sit at this desk.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A budget line older than the thing that administers it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Systems do not have owners. That is the first line of the training. Systems do not have owners, and this one is paying rent.
